sink_summary: The substitutions dictionary is used to render an email template (line 99) where values are interpolated using Python's string formatting (%). The rendered content is then sent via SMTP (line 66 in emailutils.py).
guard_summary: There are no explicit validation or sanitization checks on the user-provided data before it is added to substitutions. The sendEmail function does create HTML-escaped versions of values (_forhtml) but this is for HTML rendering, not for preventing injection in template strings.
